faqs.question: What kinds of handyman jobs can you help with?
faqs.answer: Furniture assembly, shelf and TV mounting, window treatments, door hardware, drywall patching, touch-up painting and minor plumbing are all part of the service list. Send your to-do list and photos to discuss the exact work.

faqs.question: What electrical work does BrightLink handle?
faqs.answer: Minor electrical projects include receptacle replacement, additional outlets, light-fixture and ceiling-fan replacement, and doorbell transformers. Share photos of your current setup and the equipment you want installed so the work and materials can be discussed before scheduling.

faqs.question: Can you help with smart home setup and Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Services include video doorbells, smart locks, thermostats, lighting, mesh Wi-Fi, Ethernet cabling, wireless bridges, security cameras and home audio. Include the brands or model numbers you already have.

faqs.question: Which areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: BrightLink serves the Cleveland, Ohio area. Share your city or neighborhood so Thomas can confirm whether your location and requested timing can be accommodated.

faqs.question: How do I get started or ask about pricing?
faqs.answer: Call or text 440-719-9436, or email brightlinkcle@gmail.com. Describe the work, your location and preferred timing, and include photos where possible. Scope, materials and scheduling are discussed individually.
